channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Vehicle on Fire on N25 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of vehicle on fire, eastbound, on the N25 between Junction 2 Little Island and Junction 3 Cobh (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 6 March at 07:18.

item.title: Collision on Sarsfield Road
item.description: Reports of a collision on Sarsfield Road near the junction with Eagle Valley. Take care on approach.

item.title: Ireland's €300 Million Scam Crisis: What You Need to Know
item.description: Ireland is receiving around 59 million scam calls and 47 million scam texts every year. The network defences are improving, but the best barrier remains an informed public.

item.title: RSA: Three Killed and 54 Seriously Injured in Scrambler Collisions Since 2021
item.description: RSA data shows 3 killed and 54 seriously injured in scrambler collisions on Irish public roads from 2021 to 2025, with 4 incidents recorded in Cork.

item.title: Broken-down Vehicle on M8 Northbound
item.description: Reports of a broken-down vehicle, northbound, on the M8 Dublin Motorway between Junction 12 (N73) Mitchelstown (North) and Junction 11 Cahir (South) (3 kilometres south of the Cahir area). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 6 March at 14:50.

item.title: M28 Motorway: Works Progress Across Multiple Locations as Lane Closures Loom
item.description: M28 works update: Multiple road closures and traffic management measures in place this week, with more restrictions due at Carr's Hill and Rochestown by end of March.

item.title: Collision on McCurtain Street Fermoy
item.description: Reports of a collision on McCurtain Street Fermoy. Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on R576 near Allensbridge
item.description: Reports of a collision on the R576 between Kanturk and Newmarket near Allensbridge. Emergency services are on scene. Take care on approach.

item.title: Government Monitoring Energy Prices as Middle East Conflict Drives Global Market Uncertainty
item.description: Ireland's Energy Security Group meets amid Middle East tensions; Govt. say fuel supplies remain stable and Budget 2026 supports are in place for households struggling with costs.
